What Element Solutions says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDA and EPS growthThe Company now expects full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to be approximately $720 million, inclusive of full year contributions from the Micromax and EFC acquisitions and assuming stable exchange rates and metal prices, and an adjusted EPS growth rate of over 20% for the full year.
